insights.summary: Spend grew from $190k to $268k in two years, mostly AI Voice Agent; finance needs the number to come down.
insights.quote: We went from a hundred and ninety to two sixty-eight over two years, and the AI Voice Agent piece is most of that. I need that number to come down.

insights.summary: CallRail claims same-day Google conversion sync and quoted lower.
insights.quote: CallRail told us they can send conversions to Google the same day, and their quote was a lot lower.

insights.summary: Finance will not sign at the current price and will run an RFP.
insights.quote: I'm not going to sign a renewal at this number. We'll run an RFP if we have to.
